name: VitaminX DetectiveB6
source:
The story puts our Vitamin X cast into an alternate universe where Minami Yuri is the Chief of her detective agency and the B6 are her employees! They get people asking them to solve cases such as finding a cat or seeing if someone’s husband is cheating on his wife. The T6 have taken random jobs around town (such as bartender or barber) but they do help out with various cases along the way. Ultimately it all boils down to a pair of art thieves and something fishy going on with the Mayor in town.

[from [url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/02/20/otome-game-review-vitamin-x-detective-b6/]Hinano's blog[/url]]
translation:
故事將《Vitamin X》的角色們帶入一個平行世界：南悠里是自己偵探社的社長，而B6則是她的員工！他們會接到各種委託，例如尋找貓，或調查某人的丈夫是否出軌。T6在城裡做著酒保、理髮師等各種臨時工作，但也會一路協助處理案件。最終，一切都指向一對藝術品竊賊，以及鎮長身上發生的可疑事情。

［來自[url=http://breadmasterlee.com/2012/02/20/otome-game-review-vitamin-x-detective-b6/]Hinano的部落格[/url]］
